newsitem.title: RUSSIA: CSFB, Salomon said leading MGTS Eurobond.
newsitem.headline: CSFB, Salomon said leading MGTS Eurobond.

text.p: Moscow telephone company MGTS intends to award CS First Boston and Salomon Bros the mandate to lead its planned Eurobond, a source close to the company said on Monday.
"So far nothing has been signed, but the managers will most likely be CSFB and Salomon," he said.
OAO Moskovskaya Gorodskaya Telefonnaya Set intends to raise $75-$100 million from the Eurobond, to be launched in the second quarter of this year, he said.
Last November MGTS's head of securities, Boris Lastovich, said the company was considering issuing a privately placed Eurobond, but was not planning an issue of American Depositary Receipts (ADRs).
